prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 – Summary (under 500 words)

Core vision: A “fair deal” built on five themes — a stronger green economy, world-class public services, restored nature, an open and rights-based UK at home and abroad, and a truly fair democracy.

Economy and jobs
- Drive growth via green investment: emergency home energy upgrades, renewables (90% electricity by 2030), skills and innovation.  
- Repair UK–EU relations, remove trade barriers, seek veterinary/plant health deals and, longer term, rejoin the Single Market.  
- Support small businesses: abolish business rates, replace with a Commercial Landowner Levy; tackle late payments; expand the British Business Bank; local banking.  
- Tax reform: reverse bank tax cuts; one-off proper windfall tax on oil/gas; raise Digital Services Tax to 6%; close CGT loopholes; 4% tax on FTSE-100 share buybacks.  
- Skills: replace apprenticeship levy with a flexible skills levy; Lifelong Skills Grants (£5,000 initially); boost apprenticeships; AI innovation with clear regulation.

Health and care
- Right to see a GP within seven days (24 hours urgent) by recruiting 8,000 more GPs and expanding pharmacy roles; urgent access to NHS dentistry.  
- Mental health: walk-in hubs for young people in every community; a qualified mental health professional in every school; regular MH check-ups.  
- Cancer guarantee: 100% start treatment within 62 days; more radiotherapy machines and cancer nurses.  
- Social care: free personal care; a Royal College of Care Workers; a Carer’s Minimum Wage (+£2/hour); paid carer’s leave and guaranteed respite; cross-party long-term funding.

Environment and energy
- Net zero by 2045; rooftop solar revolution; free insulation and heat pumps for low-income households; social energy tariff; decouple electricity from gas prices.  
- Keep fracking banned; no new coal mines; invest in storage, hydrogen and grid upgrades.  
- End the sewage scandal: turn water firms into public benefit companies; ban executive bonuses until discharges end; tougher regulator; Sewage Tax; real-time spill data.  
- Nature: legally binding targets to “double nature” by 2050; plant 60m trees/year; Clean Air Act with an Air Quality Agency.

Education and families
- Per-pupil funding to rise above inflation; fix crumbling buildings; tutoring guarantee for disadvantaged pupils; SEND funding overhaul.  
- Early years: extra free hours for disadvantaged 3–4 year-olds; triple Early Years Pupil Premium; restore childminding; return to Erasmus+.  
- Parental leave: day-one rights incl. self-employed; double Statutory Maternity/Shared Parental Pay to £350/week; 90% pay for paternity and an extra month for fathers/partners.  
- Extend free school meals to all children in poverty (aim: all primary pupils).

Housing and communities
- Build 380,000 homes/year, incl. 150,000 social; 10 new garden cities; “use-it-or-lose-it” permissions; empower councils on land and planning fees.  
- Renters: ban no-fault evictions; three-year default tenancies; national landlord register.  
- Abolish residential leasehold; cap ground rents; remove dangerous cladding at no cost to leaseholders; Rent-to-Own for social housing.  
- End rough sleeping; scrap the Vagrancy Act.  
- Local power and funding stability; controls on second homes/short-term lets; universal gigabit broadband.

Crime, rights and democracy
- Restore community policing; guarantee police attend all burglaries; Online Crime Agency; halve court delays; Hillsborough Law.  
- Human Rights Act protected; repeal anti-protest laws; misogyny a hate crime; ban conversion therapy; flexible-working right; gender recognition reform.  
- Political reform: proportional representation (STV) for Commons and English councils; votes at 16; cap donations; reform Lords; Ministerial Code in law.

Immigration and asylum
- End the Hostile Environment; scrap the Illegal Migration Act and Rwanda scheme; safe/legal routes; process asylum claims within three months; allow work after three months; flexible work visa rules; protect EU citizens’ rights.

Transport, culture, defence, international
- EV switch: mass charging rollout, restore 2030 ZEV mandate, plug-in grant; freeze rail fares; electrify rail; empower bus franchising; active travel.  
- Protect BBC/Channel 4; Creative Europe participation; simple EU touring for artists; sports and leisure investment.  
- Defence: reverse Army cuts; spend towards 2.5% of GDP; maintain nuclear deterrent; tighter arms export controls; better forces housing and support.  
- International: rebuild ties with Europe via a four-stage roadmap; restore 0.7% aid; stand with Ukraine; push ceasefire and two-state solution, recognise Palestine; climate leadership; clamp down on kleptocracy.
